protocol: Persistent isolated public NumPy API workers. All GPU/CPU timed calls are serial. Cold first fit/query is separate; every operation gets the stated count of warmups per variant. Variant starting order rotates by dataset and operation, and each round reverses it. Each call is synchronized and audited outside timing. fit_query includes a fresh fit and all first-query preparation. No result caching. Inputs are the same float32 arrays for all variants, with no rescaling or jitter. Real data use raw features and stratified holdouts. Synthetic inputs and real-data split seeds are preserved per fixture.
accuracy_reference: Exhaustive direct float64 differences on actual float32 coordinates; canonical distance/index order. Strict index and prediction mismatches remain failures. A separate query audit recognizes exact-distance-valid alternative tie choices; it never changes strict pass. Prediction mismatches on tied fixtures are marked ambiguous, not automatically accepted. Distance atol/rtol1e-6; existing prediction tolerance retained.
two_x_policy: Nine search/inference operations, excluding fit-only. Report both ratio of per-variant medians and EVERY retained paired call>=2x. Do not average away misses. Speed results and accuracy qualifications are separate; failures remain in raw records.

fixtures.oracle: exhaustive direct float64 squared differences on actual float32 coordinates; exact lexsort(squared distance,index)

parameters.preprocessing: raw features converted to float32; no scaling or jitter

fixtures.regression_response: numeric class labels used as a benchmark response; not a regression-quality claim
